verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's Create Event API lets developers fire a custom event tied to a profile, and Klaviyo flows can be triggered by such custom events to run for that specific person (per-profile automation), with arbitrary event data schema support and server-side SDKs to send events. missing for 10: no explicit docs snippet showing flow-trigger configuration UI tied to a custom event metric, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end trigger behavior.
